title: thermal-capture
description:
This repository holds research on contained thermal systems. It asks whether heat in ordinary air can be turned into electricity, and tests each route against measured numbers.

Status: research direction only. No device has been built under this project. No result is claimed beyond the published work cited in DIRECTION.md.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
